---
title: Projects
---

## View Classification of Cardiac MRI (Current)

Automating view classification of cardiac MRIs utilizing DICOM metadata as part of the tandon lab at Cleveland Clinic Children's.

----

## Leveraging Generative AI Tools to Track Long-Term Leadership Trajectories in Academic Medicine (Current)

Utilizing generative AI to assess efficacy of leadership development programs for women in academic medicine at CWRU School of Medicine Clinical and Translational Science Collaborative and CWRU Weatherhead School of Management.

----

## Development and Validation of a Simplified Martin-Hopkins LDL-C Equation Using Machine Learning (2026)

Validated a machine-learning based model to recalculate low density lipoprotein cholesterol to improve accuracy on Mayo Clinic laboratory data, and published findings in JAMA Cardiology.

----

## Feasibility of Capillary Self-Collected Blood Specimens for Routine Outpatient Laboratory Testing (2026)

Evaluated the clinical efficacy and viability of at-home capillary blood collection device for outpatient diagnostic testing at Mayo Clinic. Presenting findings at the Association for Diagnostics & Laboratory Medicine Pre-Analytical Phase Conference, and published manuscript in the Journal of Applied Laboratory Medicine.

----

## Tumor metrics imaging core labs: primer for radiologists (2026)

First-authored a review paper discussing the role, importance, benefits, and costs of tumor metrics imaging core labs for oncological clinical trials. Published review in Abdominal Radiology.

----

## Revisiting MRI Claustrophobia: Incidence, Factors, and Interventions, Journal of Computer Assisted Tomography (2025)

Assisted in writing a review paper encompassing claustrophobia in MRI imaging, including incidence, causes, and potential interventions. Published review in the Journal of Computer Assisted Tomography.

----

## Patient-Reported Testing Burden of Screening Contrast Enhanced Mammography (2023)

Assessed the testing burden through patient-reported surveys of screening contrast-enhanced mammography for high-risk patients. Published results in the Journal of the American College of Radiology.
